basic_details.job_title: District Judiciary, Khurda Local Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One local person is required on a daily wage basis, with knowledge of cooking, sweeping, housekeeping etc., to work in the Court of Civil Judge (Jr. Divn.)-cum-JMFC, Tangi and meet the services of a Group-D employee. Applications must be submitted in the office of the Process Establishment Section, Civil Court Complex, Khurda, and must be received there by 19 November 2026 till 4.00 PM. The notice (Notice No. 01, dated 16 November 2026) is issued by the Office of the S.D.J.M.-cum-J.I.C., Process Establishment Section, Khurda.

content_sections.heading: About Khurda District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the S.D.J.M.-cum-J.I.C., Process Establishment Section, Khurda, which functions from the Civil Court Complex, Khurda under the District Judiciary, Khurda, Odisha. The person engaged will work in the Court of Civil Judge (Jr. Divn.)-cum-JMFC, Tangi, and the engagement is for post-facto approval of the Hon'ble District Judge, Khurda at Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application is submitted in person at this office: Process Establishment Section, Civil Court Complex, Khurda. The notice prints no PIN code and no postal mode; it asks candidates to submit their applications in the office, and the application must be received there with all requisites by 19 November 2026 till 4.00 PM. The application is written on plain paper as per the application format attached to the notice. The format asks for these details: Name of the applicant (in capital letters) Father's Name (in capital letters) Educational qualification Date of Birth Nationality Permanent address with PIN code (in capital letters) Present Address for communication with PIN code (in capital letters) Present age (as on the date filled in by the candidate) Marital Status Experience if any Contact Phone No. The form ends with Place, Date and the Signature of Candidate, and has a box to affix a self-signed recent colour passport size photograph.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one vacancy: one local person on a daily wage basis to meet the services of a Group-D employee in the Court of Civil Judge (Jr. Divn.)-cum-JMFC, Tangi. Who can apply: a local person having knowledge regarding cooking, sweeping, housekeeping etc. Educational qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application format asks candidates to state their educational qualification and experience, if any. Age limit: not below 18 years and not above 42 years as on 20.11.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Pay: daily wages as per Notification No.6100/LC, BBSR, dated 20.10.2020 and Notification No.2602/LC, BBSR, dated 30.04.2025 of the Labour Commissioner, Odisha, with respect to minimum notified wages including VDA per day, subject to revision by Govt. from time to time. The notice does not print a rupee amount. Nature of engagement: purely on a temporary basis and terminable at any time. The engagement will confer no right to claim appointment on a regular basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for this engagement.

content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and the final personal interview of the shortlisted candidates will be conducted on 20 November 2026 at about 4.05 PM in the Video Conference Hall of the Civil Court complex, Khurda. The notice does not mention a written test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Khurda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy: one local person on a daily wage basis for Group-D services in the Court of Civil Judge (Jr. Divn.)-cum-JMFC, Tangi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be received in the office of the Process Establishment Section, Civil Court Complex, Khurda by 19 November 2026 till 4.00 PM. Late or incomplete applications shall be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The candidate must be a local person with knowledge regarding cooking, sweeping, housekeeping etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant must be not below 18 years and not above 42 years as on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The person engaged will be paid daily wages as per the minimum notified wages including VDA per day under the Labour Commissioner, Odisha notifications dated 20.10.2020 and 30.04.2025, subject to revision by Govt. from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Write the application on plain paper as per the attached format, enclose attested photocopy and documents in support of age and one passport size photograph, and submit it in the office of the Process Establishment Section, Civil Court Complex, Khurda.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will face a final personal interview on 20 November 2026 at about 4.05 PM in the Video Conference Hall of the Civil Court complex, Khurda.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a temporary basis, is terminable at any time and confers no right to claim appointment on a regular basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected person work?
faq.answer: The selected person will work in the Court of Civil Judge (Jr. Divn.)-cum-JMFC, Tangi.
